reviews.author: mahesh yadla
reviews.text:
Problem / Reason of my visit:
I have gone to Dr. Giridhar after my wisdom tooth broke which was decayed in the past. I've already got that treated where it was drilled and cemented in a different clinic where my experience wasn't very good.

Procedure:
I've been made aware of the options that I have (root canal or extraction) before hand. Dr. Giridhar helped me in understanding the pros and cons of each approach and helped me make the right decision.

Experience:
I've had complete knowledge of what was happening through out the procedure as I was clearly explained of each step. Giri cared through out the process, kept asking me if I felt comfortable and have given me more confidence.

I'd definitely recommend him to anyone over the private dental hospitals where you'd have to wait several hours and be kept in dark of your options.

Pricing:
The price is very reasonable and helps everyone.
